provenance.bg.surface: spec: CursorLine = bg_highlight; port: Textual surface ~ bg_highlight
provenance.bg.raised: spec: PmenuSel bg = blend(fg_gutter, 0.8) over bg (also helix extras ui.menu.selected) [derived: blend(fg_gutter, bg, 0.8)]
provenance.bg.overlay: spec: Pmenu/NormalFloat bg = bg_popup/bg_float = bg_dark (floats sit below bg)
provenance.fg.muted: spec: fg_sidebar = fg_dark; StatusLine, MsgArea, ModeMsg use fg_dark
provenance.fg.faint: spec: dark5 = Conceal, qfLineNr, inactive/hidden buffer and tab labels; comment (consensus 2/3) fails 3:1 in night/storm/day
provenance.fg.on-accent: choice: Day's `black` is light grey #b4b5b9 (1.96:1 on blue); bg gives the highest ratio on the mid-tone accents
provenance.fg.title: spec: Title = blue bold
provenance.border.default: choice: single focus indicator (audit-checklist FS-09) — the ports use border_highlight (consensus 3/5), a saturated cyan nearly as strong as the orange focus border; dark3 is the neutral between `border` (invisible) and border_highlight
provenance.border.focus: port: official extras/lazygit activeBorderColor = orange, paired with border_highlight inactive (no consensus: 1/4 each)
provenance.accent.primary: consensus: 2/3 ports (helix statusline.normal, yazi mode.normal); Directory/MoreMsg = blue
provenance.selection.bg: consensus: bg_highlight 3/6 ports; the PmenuSel blend gives only 2.98:1 with fg on Day
provenance.selection.fg: spec: PmenuSel sets bg only (fg passes through)
provenance.status.success: port: Textual success = green; ANSI green
provenance.keyhint.key: consensus: 2/4 ports (Textual footer key = $accent, btop hi_fg)

notes: Day is computed at runtime (Util.invert of night); extras/lua/tokyonight_day.lua is the only static source.
Light-theme limit: fg_dark, red1, yellow, green and blue2 all sit between 3.0:1 and 4.5:1 on bg #e1e2e7; no same-role entry passes.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): border.focus -> '11' (slot 4 #2e7de9 is not the #b15c00 hue; slot 11 = #a27629, 3.15:1) | keyhint.key -> '11' (slot 4 is 3.11:1; slot 4 #2e7de9 is not the #b15c00 hue; slot 11 = #a27629, 3.15:1) | diff.changed -> '3' (slot 4 #2e7de9 is not the #8c6c3e hue; slot 3 = #8c6c3e, 3.75:1) | fg.muted -> '15' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.16:1; now 4.52:1) | fg.faint -> '7' (default '8' resolves to 1.85:1; now 3.57:1) | keyhint.desc -> '7' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.16:1; now 3.57:1) | tab.inactive.fg -> '7' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.16:1; now 3.57:1) | tab.active.bg -> '4', tab.active.fg -> 'bg bold' (the theme draws a filled active tab: #e1e2e7 on #2e7de9)
